raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00 with 345 rows duplicating txn_ids already delivered at 02:00. The fix parses both timestamp formats and keeps one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'), dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) AS rn FROM parsed) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1;"}}
